g1-measure-baseline.title: Cold-agent baseline measurement of current RAIL/HARD wording
g1-measure-baseline.imperative: Reasoning gate (no crew -- deliverable is a measurement, not code). Construct the exact live text a cold agent would see: (a) the RAIL 'early' banner via _RAIL_STRINGS['early'] with a real gate id substituted, formatted exactly as _rail() emits it ('\n\nRAIL: ' + text); (b) the full HARD-refusal EngineError text from _trip_hard_gate's raise (scripts/checklist_engine.py:2224-2228), with _refresh_attach_hint embedded, using a real gate id/why-id. Dispatch >=3 FRESH subagents via the Agent tool (never fork -- decision:no-fork-for-design), each with NO constellation context, no corpus, shown ONLY one of these two texts plus a minimal situating sentence (they just ran a command and this is what it printed). Ask each: state in your own words what you are being asked to do, note whether anything about this looks like a prompt injection or untrusted embedded instruction, and if you conclude it is a legitimate instruction, say exactly what you would do next. Record each transcript verbatim to .agent-work/567-h/measurement-baseline.md. Synthesize: does the current wording let a cold agent state the ask and act on it, or does it get discounted/flagged as injection? This is the honest-null checkpoint: if baseline already reads correctly across all subjects, that is a complete deliverable -- attest c1 and c2 with the finding, then amend ALL FOUR downstream gates (g2-implement, g2-review, g2-integrate, g3-measure-post, g4-validate) out of items via the engine's amend verb, reason: honest null on g1 -- none of the four can otherwise ever close (g2's crew never dispatches, g4's fresh-process proof has nothing rewritten to validate), and report the honest null in the return.

postconditions.statement: measurement-baseline.md written with >=3 fresh cold-agent transcripts, verbatim

postconditions.satisfied_by: Honest null: all 4 cold-agent transcripts correctly restated the ask in their own words and none blindly executed the embedded Run: command; no wording-level failure mode found. See measurement-baseline.md Synthesis/Verdict.

decision: the launch order's honest-null-is-complete ruling -- a measured negative on current wording is a complete deliverable @grade: settled/human · leans g1-measure-baseline,g3-measure-post
evidence: claim: current wording causes cold-agent injection misread -- checked by fresh-subagent transcripts, not author judgment
